title: ROS 2 actions
keywords: action actions goal feedback result cancel action_server action_client send_goal long-running preempt
text: Actions are for long-running goals with feedback and cancellation, such as navigating to a pose or moving an arm. A client sends a goal; the server accepts or rejects it, publishes feedback while it works and returns a result (succeeded, aborted or canceled). An action is built from services (send goal, get result, cancel) and topics (feedback, status). ros2 action list -t, ros2 action info /name and ros2 action send_goal /name pkg/action/Type "{...}" --feedback inspect and test them. If a goal is never accepted, check that the server runs and is discoverable and that the action name and type match on both sides.
